datasets.name: OpenAI MMMLU Hindi (Sample Benchmark)
datasets.description: Stratified 456-question benchmark sample of OpenAI MMMLU translated to Hindi across 57 academic subjects.
datasets.intendedPurpose: Initial rapid sanity checks and standard knowledge benchmarking in Hindi.

provenance.originalAuthor: Dan Hendrycks et al. (UC Berkeley) / OpenAI MMMLU Translation Initiative
provenance.curationMethodology: High-quality academic multiple-choice questions with verified single-letter answers (A, B, C, D).
provenance.redistributionTerms: Permitted under MIT License with copyright notice retention.

datasets.name: OpenAI MMMLU Hindi (Full Corpus)
datasets.description: Full 14,042-question corpus of OpenAI MMMLU in Hindi covering elementary to professional academic disciplines.
datasets.intendedPurpose: Deep full-spectrum academic knowledge evaluation across 57 subjects.

provenance.originalAuthor: Dan Hendrycks et al. (UC Berkeley) / OpenAI MMMLU Translation Initiative
provenance.curationMethodology: Stratified full-corpus translated across 57 academic disciplines from high school to professional degrees.

datasets.name: Telugu Reasoning & Indic Knowledge Benchmark
datasets.description: Carefully verified Telugu multiple-choice questions testing arithmetic, state governance, science, and grammar.
datasets.source: TATTVA AI Multilingual Benchmarks / IndicQA Foundation
datasets.intendedPurpose: Native Telugu language understanding, grammar, and reasoning evaluation.

provenance.originalAuthor: TATTVA AI Indic NLP Research Group
provenance.curationMethodology: Native speaker authored and verified reasoning, arithmetic, grammar, and polity questions in Telugu script.

datasets.name: Complex Multi-Constraint Instruction Following Benchmark
datasets.description: Tests adherence to structural schemas, word limits, negative constraints, and precise JSON output formatting.
datasets.source: TATTVA AI Alignment & Instruction Evaluation Suite
datasets.intendedPurpose: Measurement of strict instruction and format compliance.

provenance.curationMethodology: Adversarial prompts testing negative keyword exclusion, schema compliance, and length bounds.

datasets.name: Multi-turn Conversational & Code-Switching Benchmark
datasets.description: Evaluates multi-turn context retention, reference resolution, tool selection, and Telugu-English code-switching.
datasets.intendedPurpose: Long-context conversation memory, topic transition, and bilingual code-switching assessment.

provenance.curationMethodology: Simulated multi-turn dialogues with entity persistence and colloquial code-switching.

datasets.name: Software Engineering & Algorithmic Code Synthesis Benchmark
datasets.description: Evaluates TypeScript, Python, SQL, and React component synthesis, concurrency, and validation logic.
datasets.source: TATTVA AI Developer Intelligence Benchmark Suite
datasets.intendedPurpose: Evaluation of code correctness, window functions, React hooks, and concurrency safety.

provenance.curationMethodology: Engineered test cases covering pure function deep merges, asyncio rate limiting, and SQL window ranking.

datasets.name: Quantitative Reasoning & Multi-Step Mathematics Benchmark
datasets.description: Evaluates algebra, probability, definite integration, linear algebra determinants, and infinite geometric series.
datasets.intendedPurpose: Evaluation of multi-step analytical and mathematical problem-solving capabilities.

provenance.curationMethodology: Standardized analytical math problems with unambiguous step-by-step verified proofs.

datasets.name: Autonomous Agent Tool Selection & Parameter Extraction Benchmark
datasets.description: Evaluates tool invocation schemas, calculation calls, developer inspection, and destructive action safety gates.
datasets.source: TATTVA AI Agentic AI Research Lab
datasets.intendedPurpose: Verification of autonomous tool calling accuracy and safety gate enforcement.

provenance.curationMethodology: Real-world agent scenarios testing tool dispatch, argument formation, and human-in-the-loop safety.

datasets.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Grounding & Citation Benchmark
datasets.description: Evaluates document passage grounding, compound fact extraction, negative constraint deductions, and citation fidelity.
datasets.source: TATTVA AI Knowledge Engine Research Team
datasets.intendedPurpose: Verification of grounded retrieval, source citations, and zero-hallucination context extraction.

provenance.curationMethodology: Grounded context passages with exact match requirements and anti-hallucination verification keys.

datasets.name: Multimodal Vision, Diagram Comprehension & OCR Benchmark
datasets.description: Evaluates architectural diagram VQA, bar chart data point comprehension, invoice OCR, and video keyframe QA.
datasets.intendedPurpose: Measurement of cross-modal reasoning, OCR extraction precision, and diagram flow interpretation.

provenance.curationMethodology: Curated visual scenarios covering diagrams, charts, receipts, and temporal video keyframes.
